verdict.rationale: PayPal is an API-first service built for headless use. Apps authenticate machine-to-machine by exchanging a client ID and secret for an access token, then call REST APIs (Invoicing, Disputes, Payouts) programmatically from backend systems. A self-contained sandbox suits automated testing, and the local MCP server runs non-interactively via `npx -y @paypal/mcp` configured purely by environment variables (PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN, PAYPAL_ENVIRONMENT=SANDBOX|PRODUCTION). Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, an official general-purpose CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
